reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Those are two different questions, so here's each. Alcohol blunts recovery, hurts sleep, and slows muscle repair, so keep it light on training nights and never drink heavily before a session. Pre-workout is mostly caffeine plus other stimulants and ingredients; a standard dose is fine for most healthy adults, but skip it late in the day so it doesn't wreck your sleep, and check with a doctor if you have a heart condition or take medication. Anything beyond that is a question for your doctor or a dietitian."}
